                                  JOIN title_b_preorder b USING (player_id)) AS all_three
"})

caveats: This answer was produced as signed-in-user@example.com and covers only the data that identity is granted. Unity Catalog row filters and column masks apply without reporting themselves, so figures here may be computed from a subset of the rows another reader would see.
The all-three group of 120 is small. Do not break it down by country, platform or any other dimension.
is_pre_order has no column comment, so how completely it is populated is unknown.
played_title_a has no date column, so 'played Title A' means ever, not within a window.
'Ever held Membership X' counts any row in membership_history, with no active filter applied.

WITH members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM example_catalog.example_schema.membership_history WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
),
title_a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM example_catalog.example_schema.play_by_title WHERE played_title_a = 'True' AND player_id IS NOT NULL
),
title_b_preorder AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM example_catalog.example_schema.title_b_summary WHERE is_pre_order = TRUE AND player_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members) AS members,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM title_a) AS title_a_players,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM title_b_preorder) AS title_b_preorders,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members m JOIN title_a a USING (player_id)
                                  JOIN title_b_preorder b USING (player_id)) AS all_three
